title: Independent or Dependent?
description: Decide whether each clause expresses a complete thought or depends on another clause.
directions: A clause contains a subject and a verb. Decide whether each clause expresses a complete thought by itself or depends on another clause to complete its meaning.

questions.prompt: The auditorium doors opened at seven
questions.explanation: “Doors” is the subject and “opened” is the verb. The clause expresses a complete thought, so it is an independent clause.
questions.reviewTopic: Recognizing subjects, verbs, and complete thoughts
